fusions.name: Prised Open
fusions.desc: Pries a target open for 28 damage that ignores armour, and leaves it 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Reef Scramble
fusions.desc: Scrambles over the cutting edge, dealing 8 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and leaving each [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. It also costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Lay No Hand
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Each kill you make while it is active restores 5 health.

fusions.name: Gleaner's Edge
fusions.desc: Against enemies below 50% health, you deal 12% more damage. You also have 5% more dodge chance.
